content.text:
Search map has concrete drift.

- Landing `/` now offers a “Search MPs and funders” link, not a search box. `frontend/src/LandingPage.svelte:11`.
- Search lives at `/search?q=…`. No similarity slider exists. Strictness is fixed at 0.8, and legacy `strictness` URLs redirect after removing that parameter. `frontend/src/lib/search.ts:5`, `frontend/src/routes/[...path]/+page.server.ts:9`.
- Browser requests go through SvelteKit server loads. Only server code calls Rust `/search`, using `term`, `max_entries=10`, and `strictness=0.8`. `frontend/src/routes/[...path]/+page.server.ts:37`, `frontend/src/lib/server/search.ts:81`.
- People fallback condition is more precise than “no primary people match”. It requires no primary MPs and no qualifying individual funder. `exposed/src/lib/domain/services/entity_search.rs:53`.
- Existing HTTP cases remain supported by `scripts/search-regression.json:1` and `exposed/tests/integration.rs:255`. I did not execute them.

Missing user-facing coverage worth adding to the map.

- Three Unicode characters minimum, 250 ms debounce, Enter resubmission, composition handling, clear and keyboard shortcuts. `frontend/src/SearchPage.svelte:49`, `:68`, `:128`, `:180`.
- Idle examples, loading skeleton, retry, empty-result editing, result-limit advice. `frontend/src/SearchPage.svelte:229`.
- Canonical links with retained query, highlighted literal text, accessible “Matched alias” provenance, MP/funder colors and kind indicators. `frontend/src/SearchPage.svelte:278`.
- Stale-response protection and legacy URL redirects have existing browser tests. `frontend/tests/search.spec.ts:232`, `:609`, `:650`.
- Executed searches emit `search_submitted` with query length; selection emits entity type, match source and position. `frontend/src/SearchPage.svelte:84`, `:295`.

Backend entry points are `exposed/src/lib/inbound/http/handlers.rs:92`, `exposed/src/lib/domain/services/entity_search.rs:42`, and `exposed/src/lib/outbound/funder.rs:42`. The funder repository selects winning aliases and deduplicates canonical groups.

Live recipe for the parent to run. Start the snapshot API and frontend with `EXPOSED_API_ORIGIN` pointing to it. Open `/`, follow the search link, type `we` and confirm the minimum-character hint. Type `west mid`, wait for results, and confirm one Unite canonical result displays `Matched alias: UNITE The Union (West Midlands)`. Follow it and verify canonical funder navigation retains `q=west+mid`; use Back, then Escape to clear. Open `/search?q=hsbc&strictness=1` and confirm it redirects to `/search?q=hsbc` and searches at fixed 0.8. Retain the existing HTTP regression as the exact ordering and provenance oracle.

No files edited or app driven.
